changeSet.comment: Test data for addresses from hotel schema
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO hotel.addresses (street, house_number, country_id, city_id, active, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CASE WHEN random() < 0.5 THEN 'Zhilunovicha' ELSE 'Polessia' END AS street, CONCAT(gs, 'a') AS house_number, ROUND(1 + random() * 19) AS country_id, ROUND(1 + random() * 19) AS city_id, true AS active, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' - (random() * interval '365 days'), NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS gs;

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO hotel.hotels (name, rating, address_id, active, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CONCAT('Hotel', gs) AS name, CASE WHEN random() < 0.5 THEN 5 ELSE 4 END AS rating, gs AS address_id, true AS active, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' - (random() * interval '365 days'), NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS gs;

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO hotel.rooms (description, room_type_id, hotel_id, active, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CONCAT('Room ', gs, ' in hotel ', t.hotel_id) AS description, ROUND(1 + random() * 9) AS room_type_id, t.hotel_id, true AS active, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' - (random() * interval '365 days'), NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'utc' FROM tmp_hotel_room_counts t, generate_series(1, t.room_count) AS gs
